{{Quote|Possak holo about some in Starship Graveyard, but never return. Not sure if killed by pirates, or tried to hunt alone. Brek pray Scorekeeper give Possak extra Jagannath for courage.|[[Brek]]'s notes|<ref name="Stalking the Score" />}}
'''Possak''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who joined the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]], a former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] that was led by [[Qyzen Fess]] during the era in which the [[Eternal Empire]] controlled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In his efforts to teach his students about the Trandoshan [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] and the glory of the hunt, Qyzen brought Possak and other Warstalkers to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to hunt beasts worthy of rewarding [[Jagannath point/Legends|jagannath points]]. Possak [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] and reported the presence of several worthy beasts, but went missing shortly afterward.<ref name="Stalking the Score" />
